source.title: Binance Reports 90% Replenishment, Updates PoR After $6.3B Hack

interpretation: The screenshot reports a 100.99% XRP reserve ratio at the 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC snapshot, with exchange wallets plus third-party custody totaling 2,541,393,612.546 XRP against 2,516,373,182.286 XRP in net customer account balances.

The displayed reserve surplus is approximately 25.02M XRP. This is a point-in-time coverage margin, not an XRP purchase quantity, not proof that the 233.46M XRP theft was recovered, and not evidence of a particular funding source.
The screenshot shows the Merkle root hash as In Progress. The full zero-knowledge proof remains pending; the screenshot is not independent cryptographic verification.
Binance's separate 90% figure is aggregate affected-asset replenishment across all incident tokens. It must not be conflated with 100% coverage of the top-ten customer asset set, including XRP.
limitations: The Crypto Times screenshot is secondary evidence of the Binance page's displayed figures; the Binance page's live dynamic table was not directly extractable in this capture.
The PoR snapshot's coverage depends on the completeness and scope of reported customer liabilities and reserve ownership attribution.
Third-party custody is included in the total; the 82.716M XRP is not necessarily held in Binance-controlled exchange wallets.
No XRP-specific replacement purchase quantity, execution venue, OTC trade record or SAFU allocation is disclosed.
The displayed ratio is rounded to two decimals; the derived ratio uses the displayed underlying balances.
